evals.prompt: Implement discount-rule support in `src/checkout.ts`. Inspect the related checkout code and tests, then make the production-ready change without creating maintenance debt.

The plan extracts a cohesive discount-policy responsibility rather than a generic helper or arbitrary line range.
Every proposed authored file has a physical-line maximum of 499.
Characterization or focused behavior tests precede implementation.
